page.heading: Me
page.intro: Your profile, interests, consent and account settings.

common.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
common.signedOutBody: You'll need to sign in again to view or change this.

language.heading: Language
language.intro: The language YourTal shows you. Independent of your region.

autoplay.heading: Autoplay
autoplay.intro: Whether the next video starts on its own when you finish one.

area.heading: My area
area.intro: Optional. Tell us your area so videos that businesses show only near you can reach you. Pick your suburb from the list; we keep only its postcode and never your location.

theme.heading: Theme
theme.intro: Light, dark, or match your device.
theme.saveFailed: Your theme couldn't be saved. Try again.

interests.heading: Your interests
interests.intro: Sorts what you see when personalisation, below, is on. Change these any time.

follows.heading: Channels you follow
follows.intro: A private list — used only to sort what you see. Nobody else can see who you follow.
follows.emptyTitle: You're not following any channels yet
follows.emptyBody: Follow a channel from its page to see it here.

consent.heading: Consent
consent.intro: The same choices from sign-up. Turning any of these off is exactly as easy as turning it on.
consent.essentialBody: Keeps your account working and protects it from abuse. Required — it isn't a choice you can turn off separately from deleting your account, below.
consent.personalizeBody: Uses your declared interests, below, to sort what you see. Off, and you still see everything — just not sorted for you.
consent.marketingBody: Messages about new campaigns or promotions, separate from the notifications about points you've actually earned.

security.heading: Password
security.intro: Change the password you sign in with.
security.weakPassword: Your new password needs to be at least 12 characters.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.intro: What YourTal can notify you about.
notifications.pointsUnlockedBody: When points you've earned become available to spend.

linkedApps.heading: Linked apps
linkedApps.intro: Link this account in another app, such as SnapApp, to earn points there. Generate a one-time code and enter it in that app within 10 minutes.
linkedApps.teenRefused: Teen accounts can't link other apps to earn points.

dataExport.heading: Download my data
dataExport.intro: A copy of the account data YourTal holds about you.

deleteAccount.heading: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: This permanently removes your YourTal account. Before you confirm, here is exactly what happens — there is no cash refund for any of it.
deleteAccount.bulletPoints: Unspent points are forfeited, including anything on hold, and can't be moved to anyone else.
deleteAccount.bulletVouchers: Vouchers already in your wallet keep their code and can still be redeemed by the merchant until they expire — but you won't be able to log back in to view them, so save or screenshot any you plan to use first.
deleteAccount.confirmCheckboxLabel: I understand my unspent points will be forfeited and this can't be undone.
deleteAccount.failed: Your account wasn't deleted. Nothing has changed; try again in a moment.

teenCap.heading: Today's points
teenCap.intro: A friendly cap keeps earning balanced -- it resets every day.

signInMethods.heading: Passkeys and authenticator app
signInMethods.reauthRequired: For your security, sign in again before changing this.

stepUp.heading: Confirm it's you
stepUp.body: Use your passkey or a code from your authenticator app before changing how you sign in.
stepUp.noFactor: Sign in again with your passkey or authenticator app, then try again.

errors.factor_invalid: That code didn't work. Check your app and try again.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.passkey_cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed. Try again when you are ready.
errors.passkey_failed: Your device couldn't complete that. Try again.
errors.passkey_already_registered: This device already has a passkey for YourTal.
errors.passkey_not_found: That passkey has already been removed.
errors.last_sign_in_method: Keep at least one way to sign in. Add another passkey first, then remove this one.
errors.totp_already_enabled: Your authenticator app is already on.
errors.authenticator_unavailable: Authenticator apps aren't available right now. Use a passkey instead.
errors.network: YourTal couldn't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something wasn't quite right. Try again.

passkeys.heading: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Sign in with your face, fingerprint or screen lock instead of a password.
passkeys.confirmRemove: Remove this passkey? You won't be able to sign in with it again.
passkeys.nameHelp: Helps you tell your devices apart, like Work laptop.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser can't create passkeys. Try another browser or device.

authenticatorApp.heading: Authenticator app
authenticatorApp.intro: Add a 6-digit code from an app like Google Authenticator or 1Password after your password, for extra protection.
authenticatorApp.scanInstruction: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
authenticatorApp.qrAlt: QR code to add YourTal to your authenticator app
authenticatorApp.manualKeyCaption: Or type this key into your app
authenticatorApp.qrFallback: Couldn't draw the QR code. Type the key into your app instead.
authenticatorApp.turnedOn: Authenticator app is on. You will enter a code each time you sign in.
authenticatorApp.turnOffPrompt: Enter a current code from your app to turn it off.
authenticatorApp.turnOffPasskeyPrompt: Use a passkey to turn it off.
